decision.status: accepted scoped fresh-Realm startup CPU improvement
decision.basis: Against the accepted c098 ABI41 parent, the frozen a35 ABI42 Date candidate passes the reported 1312 selected native checks, 106 original Test262 variants and 21 fresh Node goldens. In the separately scoped normal-overlay eight-case/eight-round follow-up, startup original improves 7.27% median / 11.59% mean and ordinary improves 7.70% median / 9.38% mean; both balanced groups improve at both boundaries. Repeated public Date reads improve at original and ordinary boundaries in that follow-up, while prior large ordinary sort/string control signals are not stable. The complete 21-case initial cohort independently shows startup gains under its tmpfs-triggered anonymous-backing scope; its observations are retained separately and never pooled with normal-cache results.
limits: This is a scoped startup CPU decision, not universal non-regression, V8/Scriptc parity or a memory improvement.

The normal-cache follow-up covers exactly eight predeclared sources at all three boundaries, not a complete normal-cache 17-fixture qualification. The complete initial21-case cohort used tmpfs-triggered anonymous native backing; retain its 504 child receipts / all 15,624 calls separately from the 192 normal-cache child receipts.

Repeated Date retained calls are slower by 1.58% median / 4.69% mean under normal cache, with both balanced groups positive. This measured Ready-state tradeoff remains unresolved and must be reported.
Date first-epoch original is slower by 3.46% median / 4.91% mean under normal cache; group medians are +7.71% and -0.14%. First-demand cost is not claimed neutral.

Join-4096 original has a repeated median slowdown: pooled +3.94%, group medians +3.72% / +4.12%, despite pooled mean -8.38%. Reverse-512 ordinary is +2.20% median / +2.37% mean with divergent groups. Keep all slower and outlier observations; no claim that unchanged JavaScript semantics makes timing variation harmless.

Normal-cache selected-case RSS is higher by approximately 0.15–0.46 MiB. The smaller dormant Date allocation slice is not a net RSS or live-memory saving. Runtime native image grows 4,880 bytes and text 4,096 bytes; observed process memory has not been causally attributed to those bytes.

The approximately 63 MiB initial admission-floor difference is independently reproduced by changing only cache filesystem for the same accepted host/image: tmpfs selects the existing anonymous-deserialization fallback, overlay selects file-backed admission. Do not pool historical/normal RSS with that initial fallback cohort or attribute the difference to Date.

Semantic scope is selected native coverage and 53 selected original Test262 files yielding 106 runner variants, not full Date/calendar or full Test262 coverage. V2-to-V3 repair reuse is test-only; the original failed AOT executable was retired and only its hash/transcripts remain, as documented in native-evidence-limits.json.
decision.next: Seal and publish the validated Date checkpoint with these timing and memory limits. Proceed to the separately reviewed append-key summary experiment against this accepted parent; keep i31 bitmap and Inline4 as later independent gates. Preserve complete Date cohorts, cache admission controls, identities and failed-attempt evidence. No further Date timing is required for this decision.
